offering_description.value: Makes and sells industrial packaging, such as steel and plastic drums, intermediate bulk containers and recycled paperboard packaging, to manufacturers across many industries, and reconditions containers for reuse. It also manages timberland.

primary_products.value: steel and plastic drums; intermediate bulk containers; closures; recycled paperboard packaging

primary_services.value: container reconditioning; container management; packaging logistics

customer_segment.value: B2B: chemical, food, paint, agricultural and industrial manufacturers

end_markets.value: chemicals; food and beverage; agriculture; paints and coatings; energy; consumer goods

revenue_model.value: product sales: industrial containers and packaging sold to manufacturers; service fees: container reconditioning and management services; other: timber and land sales from owned timberland

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes containers from steel, plastic and paperboard, sold to industrial manufacturers; service provider: reconditions and manages returnable containers for customers; asset operator: owns and manages timberland, selling timber and harvest rights
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: Operations and sales across North America, Europe, Asia, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: diversified: industrial packaging, paper packaging, timberland management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams serving multinational industrial customers; own locations: company-owned plants and container reconditioning sites; distributors / dealers: independent distributors and reconditioners
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Hazardous materials transport, environmental and workplace safety rules, including DOT and EPA requirements

notes: Recent divestitures and portfolio changes may not be fully reflected in this description.
